Flat and nested layered stochastic block models

layered_block_state.Rd

Construct, evaluate, and infer flat and hierarchical (nested) layered stochastic block models (Peixoto 2015), supporting both the conditionally independent layers model (independent = TRUE) and the discrete edge-covariate model (independent = FALSE).

Usage

layered_block_state(graph, layers, independent = TRUE, blocks = NULL,
  degree_corrected = TRUE, degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"))
layered_description_length(state, lmemb = TRUE, degree_prior = NULL)
minimize_layered_blockmodel_dl(graph, layers, independent = TRUE,
  degree_corrected = TRUE, degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"),
  B_min = 1L, B_max = Inf, refine = TRUE, epsilon = 1e-3)
nested_layered_block_state(graph, layers, independent = TRUE, levels = NULL,
  degree_corrected = TRUE, degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"))
nested_layered_level_entropy(state, degree_prior = NULL)
nested_layered_description_length(state, degree_prior = NULL)
minimize_nested_layered_blockmodel_dl(graph, layers, independent = TRUE,
  degree_corrected = TRUE, degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"),
  B_min = 1L, B_max = Inf, refine = TRUE, epsilon = 1e-3)

Arguments

graph

A graph created by graph_create.

layers

Discrete edge layer labels: either a character scalar naming an edge property stored on graph or a numeric, integer, character, factor, or logical vector of length graph_num_edges(graph).

independent

If TRUE (default), fit the conditionally independent layers model (each layer has its own active vertices, degree sequence, and block edge counts conditioned on the shared partition). If FALSE, fit the edge-covariate model (a single collapsed topology and degree sequence with categorical layer labels per block pair).

blocks

Optional 1-based integer group membership vector of length graph_num_vertices(graph).

levels

Optional non-empty list of 1-based integer label vectors for each hierarchy level.

degree_corrected

Whether to use degree correction (TRUE) or the non-degree-corrected model (FALSE).

degree_prior

Degree sequence hyperprior ("distributed" or "uniform").

state

A rgraphtool_layered_block_state or rgraphtool_nested_layered_block_state object.

lmemb

Whether to include the layer-membership description length term (applicable when independent = TRUE).

B_min, B_max

Minimum and maximum number of occupied level-0 groups.

refine

Whether to run local refinement sweeps during minimization.

epsilon

Convergence tolerance in nats.

Details

All description lengths match graph-tool 3.9's LayeredBlockState and NestedBlockState(base_state=LayeredBlockState) to machine precision for directed and undirected graphs (including parallel edges within and across layers, self-loops, isolated vertices, and blocks absent from individual layers).

Layered states integrate directly with block_membership, block_sizes, nested_levels, nested_project, nested_summary, plot_hierarchy, mcmc_sweep, mcmc_equilibrate, mcmc_anneal, sample_posterior, and model_evidence.

Value

Flat constructors and minimizers return a rgraphtool_layered_block_state; nested constructors and minimizers return a rgraphtool_nested_layered_block_state. Description length functions return a numeric scalar (or per-level numeric vector for nested_layered_level_entropy()).

References

Peixoto, T. P. (2015). Inferring the mesoscale structure of layered, edge-valued, and time-varying networks. Physical Review E 92, 042807.

See also

compare_layered_models, model_evidence, graph_set_edge_property, demo("layered_sbm")

Examples

set.seed(42)
g <- graph_create(10, directed = FALSE)
edges <- rbind(t(utils::combn(1:5, 2)), t(utils::combn(6:10, 2)),
               c(1, 6), c(2, 7), c(3, 8))
lay <- c(rep("within", 20), rep("across", 3))
graph_add_edges(g, edges)
st <- minimize_layered_blockmodel_dl(g, layers = lay, independent = TRUE)
st
#> <layered block state: degree-corrected, 2 independent layers, B = 1, description length 48.3846 nats>
nst <- minimize_nested_layered_blockmodel_dl(g, layers = lay,
                                             independent = TRUE)
nst
#> <nested layered block state: degree-corrected, 2 independent layers, 2 levels, B = 1-1, description length 48.3846 nats>
